[package]
name = "calc"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
publish = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "warn"

[profile.release]
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = "symbols"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release
cp target/release/calc ./app
